routing_corrections.title: Inference-Time Scaling for Joint Audio-Video Generation
routing_corrections.reason: Reward aggregation changes test-time selection, but the task is joint audio-video generation rather than strict speech/omni agentic control.

routing_corrections.title: MUGEN: Evaluating and Improving Multi-audio Understanding of Large Audio-Language Models
routing_corrections.reason: Audio-permutational majority aggregation changes the final answer but is neither an external evaluator nor a scalar reward.

priority_intake.title: Hearing Between the Lines: Unlocking the Reasoning Power of LLMs for Speech Evaluation
priority_intake.route_reason: TRACE separates content, voice quality and paralinguistics, then applies deterministic fusion; if later wired to action, controller role must be reassessed.

priority_intake.title: S2S-Arena: Evaluating Paralinguistic Instruction Following in Speech-to-Speech Models
priority_intake.route_reason: Speech-native pairwise comparison makes paralinguistic instruction following visible without converting the benchmark into a controller.

priority_intake.title: MTalk-Bench: Evaluating Speech-to-Speech Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues via Arena-style and Rubrics Protocols
priority_intake.route_reason: Multi-turn S2S arena and rubric protocols expose position, length and nonverbal judge limitations.

priority_intake.title: SimulU: Training-free Policy for Long-form Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation
priority_intake.route_reason: The policy manages history and output selection through model cross-attention, which violates the project's external black-box access constraint.

problem_distinctness.assessment: A distinct external-control problem remains only when scoped to continue, stop, retry, repair or rollback under noisy evaluators and finite budget; generic stopping and repair are already occupied.
problem_distinctness.uncertainty: The residual may collapse to an existing rule once one task, access contract and noise regime are fixed.

decision_causality.assessment: The candidate signals are causal only when they change the next call, stop decision, selected candidate or repair action; MUGEN is consensus selection, not evaluator gating.
decision_causality.uncertainty: Several current priors expose control edges without isolating the value of the signal from extra sampling.

measurement_validity.assessment: Comparison must separate oracle headroom, realized gain, regret, harm and unnecessary calls from proxy acceptance.
measurement_validity.uncertainty: No target task or trustworthy terminal oracle has been selected.

modality_necessity.assessment: Audio is load-bearing only if acoustics, speaker state or interaction timing changes the optimal stop or repair decision beyond transcript evidence.
modality_necessity.uncertainty: Part of the control problem may transfer unchanged from text or vision.

failure_severity.assessment: Failure includes early stop, wasted calls, rejection of a correct answer, harmful repair and latency or cost overruns.
failure_severity.uncertainty: Severity cannot be aggregated before task-specific harm and cost units are fixed.

feasibility.assessment: Multiple speech priors and local assets exist, and the comparison can proceed without model execution.
feasibility.uncertainty: Exact Stage-2A task, evaluator and asset licence have not been chosen.

reproduction_anchor.assessment: Candidate anchors include a task-matched speech stop or repair method, MUGEN as consensus aggregation and VRR-Stop as a noisy verification transfer comparator.
reproduction_anchor.uncertainty: No reproduction anchor is frozen or authorized.

scope_compatibility.assessment: External call, selection, budget and rollback actions fit the frozen API-visible control plane.
scope_compatibility.uncertainty: Model-internal policies such as SimulU remain boundaries and cannot silently become eligible anchors.

evidence_maturity.assessment: The claim is supported by routed full texts and mechanism coding, not by project reproduction.
evidence_maturity.uncertainty: No project outcome, benchmark or prototype evidence exists.

problem_distinctness.assessment: Reliability is distinct when an external proxy must support selection or repair and deterministic task success is unavailable; it is not a generic claim that audio judges are missing.
problem_distinctness.uncertainty: A task with a sufficient deterministic oracle could remove most of this problem.

decision_causality.assessment: A judge or metric becomes control evidence only when its output changes selection, stopping or repair; measurement instruments remain separate until that link is demonstrated.
decision_causality.uncertainty: Most current evidence measures agreement rather than downstream decision utility.

measurement_validity.assessment: Pointwise, pairwise, listwise and tie or abstention protocols must be separated, along with calibration, bias, human agreement and selection utility.
measurement_validity.uncertainty: Cross-protocol and cross-task comparability is not established.

modality_necessity.assessment: TRACE, S2S-Arena and MTalk-Bench provide direct reasons to preserve voice quality, prosody, speaker and nonverbal evidence beyond transcripts.
modality_necessity.uncertainty: Some dimensions can be approximated by annotations or engineered features rather than raw-audio judges.

failure_severity.assessment: An unreliable reward can systematically mis-rank candidates, stop incorrectly, amplify bias or trigger harmful repair across all downstream decisions.
failure_severity.uncertainty: The frequency and task-level harm of each failure mode remain unmeasured by this project.

feasibility.assessment: Several papers, PDFs, e-prints and repositories are local; exact unavailable or terms-gated assets retain their recorded status.
feasibility.uncertainty: A single feasible instrument and data contract has not been selected.

reproduction_anchor.assessment: TRACE offers deterministic feature fusion, while speech-native pairwise instruments and existing reward or judge studies offer contrasting anchors.
reproduction_anchor.uncertainty: No anchor is frozen and trained reward models remain boundary evidence.

scope_compatibility.assessment: Prompted or frozen external evaluators fit black-box control; trained reward models and model-internal scores are comparison boundaries.
scope_compatibility.uncertainty: API availability and cost may exclude otherwise relevant evaluators.

evidence_maturity.assessment: The bundle is measurement-rich and the four reviewer-directed works now have current routes and local full texts.
evidence_maturity.uncertainty: No evaluator has been reproduced or shown to improve project decision utility.

problem_distinctness.assessment: The residual is the divergence between terminal task success and interaction quality under interruption, timing, state update, recovery and tool use, not generic voice naturalness.
problem_distinctness.uncertainty: Observed failures may be dominated by ASR, VAD, latency or base-model capability rather than external control.

decision_causality.assessment: Signals are causal only when they change turn-taking, tool calls, recovery, state update or response timing; benchmarks alone are measurement instruments.
decision_causality.uncertainty: Current direct systems have heterogeneous and not yet normalized action contracts.

measurement_validity.assessment: Terminal success, tool correctness, interruption or barge-in handling, resume quality, latency and interaction quality must remain separate axes.
measurement_validity.uncertainty: User simulators and judge protocols may bias both task and interaction scores.

modality_necessity.assessment: Speech timing, prosody and nonverbal cues are load-bearing; audio-only and AV2AV claims remain stratified, with VideoFDB as a boundary.
modality_necessity.uncertainty: The operational omni scope does not establish GUI, robotics or universal multimodal transfer.

failure_severity.assessment: Failures include missed interruption, stale state, incorrect tool action, unsafe recovery, excessive latency and superficially natural but unsuccessful interaction.
failure_severity.uncertainty: Task-specific harm thresholds and reproducible live-interaction conditions are not fixed.

feasibility.assessment: Several voice-agent benchmarks and assets are local or revision-pinned; S2S-Arena and MTalk-Bench now add locally parsed speech-native evidence.
feasibility.uncertainty: Some exact datasets remain unavailable, terms-gated or generator-only.

reproduction_anchor.assessment: A task-matched choice among VoiceAgentBench, Full-Duplex-Bench, Audio2Tool, IHBench, S2S-Arena or MTalk-Bench could anchor Stage-2A.
reproduction_anchor.uncertainty: No benchmark or baseline has been selected or executed.

scope_compatibility.assessment: Frozen speech or omni APIs with observable tool and environment state fit the project; SimulU remains model-internal boundary evidence.
scope_compatibility.uncertainty: Some systems may require hidden streaming states or unavailable serving interfaces.

evidence_maturity.assessment: The bounded corpus contains direct systems, instruments and an explicit AV comparator, with locally available paper evidence.
evidence_maturity.uncertainty: No project reproduction, simulator validation or live-user evidence exists.

next_decision: Complete evidence-only comparison, then submit an unexecuted problem-selection dossier to the owner without ranking or selecting a winner.
